title: A square
prompt: Draw a square with sides of 40: forward 40 then turn left, four times over.
hints: A square is the same corner four times.
Write that pair four times, eight lines in all.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func solve():
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(40)
	turn_left()
